findings.title: Class 2 minimum capital differs from Table 1
findings.note: Table 1 on page 2 gives €125,000 for class 2. €150,000 is the amount for class 3.

findings.title: Subject and verb disagree: ‘licence are’
findings.note: ‘Licence’ is singular, so the verb is ‘is’.

findings.title: Term differs from the note’s own definition
findings.note: Section 8 defines ‘asset-linked token’. Use the defined term, as the same sentence does for ‘e-money tokens’.

variants.text: tokens whose value is linked to other assets

findings.title: ‘Prospectus’ where the note means the white paper
findings.note: Under the CAFR an issuer publishes a white paper (section 8), and the next sentence says ‘white paper’ too.

findings.title: Wrong article number for the capital requirements
findings.note: Footnote 1 and the definitions both give Article 26 CAFR. The digits look swapped.

findings.title: Arithmetic: a quarter of €2,140,000 is €535,000
findings.note: 2,140,000 divided by 4 is 535,000. The conclusion of the sentence still holds; the amount does not.

findings.title: Amount with one digit too many
findings.note: ‘1,000,0000’ is not a valid amount. €1,000,000 is the likely meaning; check it against the quarterly figures.

findings.title: ‘It’s’ where the possessive ‘its’ is meant
findings.note: ‘It’s’ means ‘it is’. The possessive has no apostrophe.

findings.title: Reference to a section that does not exist
findings.note: Section 7 has no subsections. The 24-hour deadline for a reconciliation difference is in Table 2.

findings.quote: Because 80% of client assets are kept in cold storage
findings.suggestion: Because at least 90% of client assets are kept in cold storage
findings.title: 80% in cold storage, where sections 1 and 4 say 90%
findings.note: Section 1 and section 4 both say at least 90% is kept in cold storage.

findings.title: The parts of the reserve add up to 110%
findings.note: 60% + 35% + 15% = 110%. One of the three shares is wrong; confirm with Treasury before the text changes.

findings.title: Reporting deadline differs from Table 2
findings.note: Table 2, just above, gives 14 days for an unusual transaction.

findings.quote: See Table 3 for the full list
findings.suggestion: See Table 2 for the full list
findings.title: There is no Table 3
findings.note: The note has two tables. The reporting deadlines are in Table 2.

findings.quote: The crypto service provider keeps a register
findings.title: Term differs from ‘crypto-asset service provider’
findings.note: Section 8 defines ‘crypto-asset service provider’. Here it means Oeverlicht itself, so the name is clearest.

variants.text: The crypto-asset service provider keeps a register

findings.title: The date does not exist: June has 30 days
findings.note: There is no 31 June. Check the date on the DASA’s acknowledgement of receipt.

findings.title: Decision period: 20 working days here, 25 above
findings.note: The paragraph above the list gives 25 working days.

findings.title: Company name misspelt
findings.note: Everywhere else it is Oeverlicht, with ‘ch’. In a declaration the exact name matters.
